name: 23rd Congress of the International Headache Society (IHC 2027)
description: The International Headache Society plans the 23rd International Headache Congress in Athens, Greece, from 9 to 11 September 2027. The congress covers clinical and scientific advances in headache disorders.

sources.note: Save the date holding page confirming dates and city; states the full official website is still in development.
IHS events listing for the same congress.

notes: The ihc2027.org site is a save the date holding page, not the full congress site. One secondary aggregator listed the end date as 12 September 2027 instead of 11 September 2027; the ihc2027.org page (9 to 11 September) was used here. Abstract and registration deadlines are not yet announced.
